result.disposition: All 13 evidence-found queue fields received source-reuse or documented-open dispositions. Current pages support the exact BXT-135 material claim, Tavelo's community-only 6.2 kg build report, the ICAN quote-form route, Tavelo's global retailer route, and current Winspace G3/G5 prices and storefront routes. Four exact current routes remain unverified because a page timed out, returned 403, resolved to a different Bianchi year/build, or sent SEKA's standard GR Shop Now path to a sold-out RDC variant. Six catalog purchase-route flags remain in this scope; ICAN and Tavelo have current global/contact routes but no verified mainland checkout. Two new dated global Winspace reference prices use the ECB 2026-09-23 USD/CNY cross-rate; no mainland price was added.

field_results.caveat: Exact BXT-135 GRX 1×11 carbon-wheel complete build supports a T700+T800 frame and T700 fork; no fiber proportions, lay-up or molding process are published.
The post reports one 6.2 kg custom build, matching 6,200 g; size, full BOM and scale protocol are unstated, so it is not a manufacturer weight.

The prior official page showed a Get a quote form; the current recheck returned HTTP 403. No quote was submitted, and current route availability and price remain unconfirmed.
The exact current manufacturer page provides a Get a quote form for the T47, UD-matte, size-M page. The form was not submitted; quote amount and mainland delivery, tax and warranty remain unknown.
The live Allegro URL now identifies 2026 YTB8DI57ZK size 57, while the Hungary page identifies YTB8DF. Neither verifies the exact target YTB8D/2025 route or its mainland availability.
The homepage lists standard ExAero GR at US$3,299, but Shop Now leads to the distinct ExAero GR RDC page, which showed sold out. That does not establish the standard GR route.
Current official products page lists Grow at US$1,650 and a retailer-finder route; selected-size checkout and mainland delivery, tax and warranty eligibility remain unverified.
Bike Insights' exact 2025 G3 table provides five sizes and the stored metrics attributed to manufacturer geometry; retain secondary-source attribution.
Current official global list price is US$1,550; the dated ECB reference conversion is CNY 10,396. It is not a mainland checkout price.
The exact page shows size selectors, Add to cart and a 10–15-business-day build-to-order lead time; selected-size stock and mainland checkout costs remain unverified.
Current official global list price is US$2,200; the dated ECB reference conversion is CNY 14,756. It is not a mainland checkout price.
